Name a config's output in the vocabulary

Source: R/lnk_vocabulary.R
lnk_vocabulary_resolve.Rd

Derives each axis's specification from what a build under cfg would actually read, and matches it against lnk_vocabulary_read():

Usage

lnk_vocabulary_resolve(cfg, loaded = NULL)

Arguments

cfg

An lnk_config object from lnk_config().

loaded

Named list from lnk_load_overrides(). Loaded from cfg when NULL.

Value

A named character vector c(cut = , acc = , grad = , flow = ).

Details

  • cut: the break sources in the order applied (pipeline: break_order, or its default), the observation breaks (all or top_per_species; only when observations is a source) and the gradient classes streams are broken at (pipeline: gradient_classes, or bcfishpass's 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 %), and which of the definite barrier, barrier control and habitat classification files the bundle declares (their rows are data, which the build record carries).

  • acc: a sha256 digest of the access rules, which decide where gradient barriers cut streams as well as what is accessible: the species the rules model, each species' access_gradient_max and observation_* lift parameters, the species presence table, which fish records make code 2 (pipeline: observation_upstream, resolved), and the two access rules held in code (the gradient class each access label maps to, and lnk_presence()'s species groups). The digest is over the parsed values, so a change in quoting or column order is not a new rule set.

  • grad: gradient=segment, the only measure link builds today.

  • flow: pipeline: discharge_source and pipeline: discharge_fill.

A config whose specification matches no token, or only a retired one, is refused: the new output gets a name (a row in inst/extdata/vocabulary.csv) before anything is built.

See also

Other vocabulary: lnk_vocabulary_read()

Examples

lnk_vocabulary_resolve(lnk_config("default"))
#>            cut            acc           grad           flow 
#> "cut-full-top"       "acc-v3"     "grad-seg"      "q-fwapg" 
lnk_vocabulary_resolve(lnk_config("bcfishpass"))
#>                cut                acc               grad               flow 
#> "cut-full-ssf-all"       "acc-bcfp-3"         "grad-seg"          "q-fwapg"
